# What does this PR do?

Exempt PRs authored by `tdene` from `@NVIDIA/reinforcement-learning` approval while preserving every other applicable owner's approval requirement.

Replace the external approval action with a repository-owned checker. The author-exemption mapping and helper live in `check_codeowners_approval.py`, and review-label automation imports that helper. Determine eligibility from the actual PR author, and stop label evaluation on GitHub API failures instead of treating failed requests as empty results. Preserve active core-team change requests even when the exemption removes every required team approval, keeping those PRs in Final Review.

## Issue tracking

Linked issue: None — CI approval-policy update.

## Code provenance

- **Source URL, revision, and original file:** Adapted from [`noamelf/codeowner-multi-approval-action/check_code_owners_approval.py`](https://github.com/noamelf/codeowner-multi-approval-action/blob/ab1d2dc274612ab9439b96538f30e88be2570f49/check_code_owners_approval.py), originally inspected at `v0.1` / `ab1d2dc274612ab9439b96538f30e88be2570f49`. The byte-identical upstream file is also published at [MIT-licensed revision `ff4f388f021bdb1bb3653c2b09e3e84f3885f50c`](https://github.com/noamelf/codeowner-multi-approval-action/blob/ff4f388f021bdb1bb3653c2b09e3e84f3885f50c/check_code_owners_approval.py); both source files have Git blob SHA `856a0aaba978eecbad5a818c047c72b6f3d198eb`.
- **File in this PR containing adapted code:** `tests/test_utils/python_scripts/check_codeowners_approval.py`.
- **Applicable license:** [MIT](https://github.com/noamelf/codeowner-multi-approval-action/blob/ff4f388f021bdb1bb3653c2b09e3e84f3885f50c/LICENSE). The original `v0.1` tree did not contain a license file; the later revision above explicitly licenses the identical source.
- **Copyright notices and attribution:** The checker header includes the source URLs and both revisions, `Copyright (c) 2025 noamelf`, and the complete upstream MIT notice, including its permission and warranty terms. NVIDIA's notice is retained.
- **Adaptation:** Preserve the existing checker's approval behavior while adding the author-specific exemption, shared policy integration, and failure handling. The exemption mapping and helper added to the checker, tests, and changes to the existing label script and workflows were written for this repository.

## Contribution process

### Pre-checks

- [x] Added 24 focused mocked tests and wired them into CI.
- [x] Ran Black, isort, Ruff, and Pylint on all changed Python files.
- Functional tests and GPU determinism coverage are not applicable to this CI-only change.
- CODEOWNERS ownership, repository settings, and Megatron runtime dependencies are unchanged.

### Validation

- All 24 tests pass, including the exact command added to CI:
  `uv run --no-project --python 3.12 --with codeowners --with pygithub python tests/test_utils/python_scripts/test_codeowners_approval.py`
- Tests cover RL-only and mixed-team changes, other authors, workflow-actor/reviewer non-exemptions, retained review blockers (including both core teams when no final team owns the changed files), advancement and reversal of review-stage labels, and GitHub API failures.
- No new Actionlint findings compared with the pre-change baseline.
- All 24 tests also pass on Python 3.10 with the label workflow's dependencies, validating its import of the consolidated checker.


- The repository formatter check completed; Black, isort, Ruff, and Pylint pass. Its non-blocking mypy step reports local-import resolution errors and an existing `_team_cache` annotation error.

<!-- nemo-ci-review-impact:v1 ceiling=moderate -->

The exemption leaves one approval-label logic error: a final-team change request can be bypassed on an RL-only PR. Reviewed all six changed files and their directly affected workflow and approval paths. Tests were not executed; the finding and suggested correction are based on source inspection.

> **Note:** formal approval is not available for this request, so this review is posted as a comment only.

*Review generated by codex. This was a full review. Request a full review with `/review reset=true`.*

<!-- nemo-ci-review-rendering:inline-v1 -->
<!-- nemo-ci-formal-review:693b4d429cc7009b3d225e275f7c37105d3053718573ca1fe3ef561e80a5ddbe:8a50c3b3b81a9b95c572785210ba3b171fd5f81707cae796593a9e67d36c1154 -->

### Preserve final-team blockers after removing the RL requirement

**Failure:** Using the added [RL-only `tdene` fixture](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/53f3dcbbdec463a95afaa3008da34843247fc605/tests/test_utils/python_scripts/test_codeowners_approval.py#L29-L44), supply latest reviews `{"nemo-reviewer": "CHANGES_REQUESTED"}` with no existing review-stage labels. This subtraction empties both required-team sets. The reviewer is correctly retained in `pending_final`, but [the stage decision](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/53f3dcbbdec463a95afaa3008da34843247fc605/tests/test_utils/python_scripts/swap_pr_labels.py#L232-L255) sets `needs_final_review=False` because no final team owns the changed files. Consequently, [the expert-stage handler](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/53f3dcbbdec463a95afaa3008da34843247fc605/tests/test_utils/python_scripts/swap_pr_labels.py#L313-L331) adds `Approved` despite the active blocker. Before the exemption, the outstanding RL approval prevented this advancement.

**Correction:** In `swap_labels`, replace the assignment at line 247 with:

```python
needs_final_review = bool(final_required or final_non_approvers)
```

This lets the existing handler retain final-review blockers even when no final team owns these paths. The invariant is that exempting a team's mandatory approval must not exempt an individual's active change request. This is a source-traced suggestion, not an executed patch; verify it before adopting.

**Acceptance and preservation — proposed checks, not run:**
- Extend `TestReviewLabels` using its default fixture and the review above; repeat with `adlr-reviewer`. Each case should add only `Final Review`, never `Approved`. Changing that review to `APPROVED` should permit `Approved`.
- Retain the existing RL-only/no-review assertion: add `Approved` once without looking up RL membership. Retain the RL-member change-request assertion: no label changes.
- Retain the other-author and mixed-training assertions: no advancement without their required approvals; mixed RL/core changes must still add `Final Review` while core approvals are missing.
- With an existing `Approved` label, a core-team change request must remove it and return to `Final Review`; with an existing `Final Review` label, the blocker must prevent advancement.

<!-- nemo-ci-review-impact:v1 ceiling=moderate -->

LGTM

**Follow-up to review 5639661481 (baseline `53f3dcbb` → head `d8e75dd9`).** I ran no tests; everything below comes from reading the source.

**Earlier finding is fixed: a core-team change request no longer gets bypassed on an RL-only PR by `tdene`.** [`swap_pr_labels.py` L247](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/d8e75dd9d33d3036be406256e7028e66b613df4b/tests/test_utils/python_scripts/swap_pr_labels.py#L247) now reads `needs_final_review = bool(final_required or final_non_approvers)`. I traced the earlier case at head: RL-only `tdene` PR, no stage label, and `{nemo-reviewer\|adlr-reviewer: CHANGES_REQUESTED}`.
- The exemption empties `required_teams`.
- `final_non_approvers` still holds the reviewer, so `needs_final_review` is True.
- The expert-stage handler adds `Final Review`, not `Approved`.

The related cases also behave correctly:
- If that reviewer approves instead, the PR advances to `Approved`.
- With an existing `Approved` label, a core change request removes it and re-adds `Final Review`.
- With an existing `Final Review` label, the PR stays put.
- Change requests from RL members and other non-core reviewers still block through `pending_expert`.

**Tests.** The four new `TestReviewLabels` cases in [`test_codeowners_approval.py`](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/d8e75dd9d33d3036be406256e7028e66b613df4b/tests/test_utils/python_scripts/test_codeowners_approval.py#L193-L229) cover both core reviewers. `test_core_member_requesting_changes_requires_final_review` would fail on the baseline and pass at head. The other three lock in the approval, revert-from-`Approved` and stay-in-`Final Review` behaviour. None of them is vacuous: `reset_mock()` keeps the fixture's return values, and labels are set before the tracker computes its stage.

**Scope.** The only changes since the baseline are the L247 fix and those four tests. `check_codeowners_approval.py`, `multi-approval-bot.yml`, `auto-swap-labels.yml` and `cicd-main.yml` are byte-identical to the previously reviewed tree. I found no new regression above the earlier impact ceiling (moderate) in the changed code or the paths it affects.

*Light-mode follow-up review.*

> **Note:** formal approval is not available for this request, so this review is posted as a comment only.

*Review generated by claude. This was a findings-only review. Request a full review with `/review reset=true`.*

+# Copyright (c) 2026 NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES. All rights reserved.

+# Original revision: ab1d2dc274612ab9439b96538f30e88be2570f49 (v0.1).

+# IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY,

+# AUTHORS OR COPYRIGHT HOLDERS BE LIABLE FOR ANY CLAIM, DAMAGES OR OTHER

+# OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE SOFTWARE OR THE USE OR OTHER DEALINGS IN THE
+# SOFTWARE.
+
+"""Require every CODEOWNERS owner to approve, subject to explicit author exemptions.
+
+Run with ``--pr-number`` and ``--repo-name`` and provide ``GITHUB_TOKEN``.
+The standalone CI environment requires codeowners and PyGithub.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import logging
+import os
+import sys
+from functools import lru_cache
+
+from codeowners import CodeOwners
+from github import Github, GithubException
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+_AUTHOR_EXEMPT_OWNERS = {"tdene": frozenset({"@NVIDIA/reinforcement-learning"})}
+
+
+def get_exempt_owners(author_login: str) -> frozenset[str]:
+    """Return fully qualified owners exempted for this pull request's author."""
+    return _AUTHOR_EXEMPT_OWNERS.get(author_login.casefold(), frozenset())
+
+
+def parse_args(argv=None):
+    """Read the same PR and repository arguments as the previous approval action."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--pr-number", required=True, type=int)
+    parser.add_argument("--repo-name", required=True)
+    return parser.parse_args(argv)
+
+
+def get_codeowners(repo):
+    """Read CODEOWNERS from the default branch, in GitHub's location priority order."""
+    for path in (".github/CODEOWNERS", "docs/CODEOWNERS", "CODEOWNERS"):
+        try:
+            contents = repo.get_contents(path)
+        except GithubException as error:
+            if error.status == 404:
+                continue
+            raise
+        logger.info("Found CODEOWNERS file at: %s", path)
+        return CodeOwners(contents.decoded_content.decode("utf-8"))
+    raise FileNotFoundError("CODEOWNERS file not found in the repository.")
+
+
+def get_modified_files(pr):
+    """Collect all changed paths, including paginated GitHub results."""
+    return [file.filename for file in pr.get_files()]
+
+
+def get_approved_reviews(pr):
+    """Preserve the previous action's evaluation of reviews in the APPROVED state."""
+    return {review.user.login for review in pr.get_reviews() if review.state == "APPROVED"}
+
+
+@lru_cache(maxsize=None)
+def get_team_members(org, team_slug):
+    """Fetch team members once per organization and team during a check."""
+    return {member.login for member in org.get_team_by_slug(team_slug).get_members()}
+
+
+def get_missing_approvals_for_file(
+    file, codeowners, approved_reviews, org, exempt_owners=frozenset()
+):
+    """Return unsatisfied owners, exempting only explicitly allowed teams."""
+    missing = []
+    for owner_type, owner_name in codeowners.of(file):
+        if owner_type == "TEAM":
+            if owner_name in exempt_owners:
+                continue
+            members = get_team_members(org, owner_name.rsplit("/", 1)[1])
+            approved = bool(members & approved_reviews)
+        else:
+            approved = owner_name.removeprefix("@") in approved_reviews
+        if not approved:
+            missing.append(owner_name)
+    return missing
+
+
+def gather_missing_approvals(
+    modified_files, codeowners, approved_reviews, org, exempt_owners=frozenset()
+):
+    """Collect missing owners for each changed file using CODEOWNERS matching."""
+    missing = {}
+    for file in modified_files:
+        owners = get_missing_approvals_for_file(
+            file, codeowners, approved_reviews, org, exempt_owners
+        )
+        if owners:
+            missing[file] = owners
+    return missing
+
+
+def check_all_owners_approved(args):
+    """Evaluate the PR using its GitHub author, never the workflow actor or reviewer."""
+    token = os.environ.get("GITHUB_TOKEN")
+    if not token:
+        raise EnvironmentError("GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable not found.")
+
+    client = Github(token)
+    repo = client.get_repo(args.repo_name)
+    pr = repo.get_pull(args.pr_number)
+    exempt_owners = get_exempt_owners(pr.user.login)
+    if exempt_owners:
+        logger.info(
+            "Author %s is exempt from approval by: %s", pr.user.login, sorted(exempt_owners)
+        )
+
+    codeowners = get_codeowners(repo)
+    modified_files = get_modified_files(pr)
+    approved_reviews = get_approved_reviews(pr)
+    org = client.get_organization(args.repo_name.split("/", 1)[0])
+    missing = gather_missing_approvals(
+        modified_files, codeowners, approved_reviews, org, exempt_owners
+    )
+    for file, owners in missing.items():
+        print(f"::error::Missing approvals for {file} from: {', '.join(owners)}")
+    if missing:
+        return False
+    logger.info("SUCCESS: All code owners have approved the PR.")
+    return True
+
+
+def main(argv=None):
+    """Report failed approvals and API errors as a failing GitHub Actions step."""
+    args = parse_args(argv)
+    try:
+        return 0 if check_all_owners_approved(args) else 1
+    except Exception as error:
+        print(f"::error::{error}")
+        return 1
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(levelname)s: %(message)s")
+    sys.exit(main())

+"""Exercise author exemptions through the approval gate and review labels."""
+
+import contextlib
+import io
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest import mock
+
+import check_codeowners_approval as checker
+import swap_pr_labels
+
+CODEOWNERS = """\
+* @NVIDIA/training
+megatron/training/ @NVIDIA/training
+megatron/rl/ @NVIDIA/reinforcement-learning
+examples/rl/ @NVIDIA/reinforcement-learning
+tests/unit_tests/rl/ @NVIDIA/reinforcement-learning
+train_rl.py @NVIDIA/reinforcement-learning
+megatron/core/ @NVIDIA/core-adlr @NVIDIA/core-nemo
+"""
+
+
+def user(login):
+    return SimpleNamespace(login=login)
+
+
+class ApprovalFixture(unittest.TestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        self.pr = mock.Mock(number=42, draft=False, user=user("tdene"), labels=[])
+        self.pr.get_files.return_value = [SimpleNamespace(filename="megatron/rl/actor.py")]
+        self.pr.get_reviews.return_value = []
+        self.repo = mock.Mock(full_name="NVIDIA/Megatron-LM", organization=user("NVIDIA"))
+        self.repo.get_pull.return_value = self.pr
+        self.repo.get_contents.return_value = SimpleNamespace(
+            decoded_content=CODEOWNERS.encode("utf-8")
+        )
+        self.team_members = {
+            "reinforcement-learning": {"rl-reviewer"},
+            "training": {"trainer"},
+            "core-adlr": {"adlr-reviewer"},
+            "core-nemo": {"nemo-reviewer"},
+        }
+        self.org = mock.Mock()
+        self.org.get_team_by_slug.side_effect = self.team
+        self.github = mock.Mock()
+        self.github.get_repo.return_value = self.repo
+        self.github.get_organization.return_value = self.org
+        patches = contextlib.ExitStack()
+        self.addCleanup(patches.close)
+        patches.enter_context(mock.patch.object(checker, "Github", return_value=self.github))
+        patches.enter_context(mock.patch.dict("os.environ", {"GITHUB_TOKEN": "test-token"}))
+
+    def team(self, slug):
+        return SimpleNamespace(get_members=lambda: [user(name) for name in self.team_members[slug]])
+
+    def set_files(self, *paths):
+        self.pr.get_files.return_value = [SimpleNamespace(filename=path) for path in paths]
+
+    def run_gate(self):
+        output = io.StringIO()
+        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output), contextlib.redirect_stderr(output):
+            result = checker.main(["--pr-number", "42", "--repo-name", "NVIDIA/Megatron-LM"])
+        return result, output.getvalue()
+
+    def tracker(self):
+        with (
+            mock.patch.object(swap_pr_labels, "Github", return_value=self.github),
+            mock.patch("builtins.open", mock.mock_open(read_data=CODEOWNERS)),
+        ):
+            return swap_pr_labels.PRReviewTracker("test-token", "NVIDIA/Megatron-LM", 42)
+
+    def swap_labels(self, tracker, reviews=None):
+        with mock.patch.object(tracker, "_get_latest_reviews", return_value=reviews or {}):
+            tracker.swap_labels()
+
+    def assert_no_label_changes(self):
+        self.pr.add_to_labels.assert_not_called()
+        self.pr.remove_from_labels.assert_not_called()
+
+
+class TestCodeownersApproval(ApprovalFixture):
+    def test_tdene_needs_no_rl_approval_for_each_owned_path(self):
+        for path in (
+            "megatron/rl/actor.py",
+            "examples/rl/train.sh",
+            "tests/unit_tests/rl/test_actor.py",
+            "train_rl.py",
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(path=path):
+                self.set_files(path)

+        self.org.get_team_by_slug.assert_not_called()
+
+    def test_author_login_is_case_insensitive(self):
+        self.pr.user.login = "TdEnE"
+        self.assertEqual(self.run_gate()[0], 0)
+
+    def test_other_teams_remain_required_on_mixed_changes(self):
+        self.set_files("megatron/rl/actor.py", "megatron/training/training.py")
+        result, output = self.run_gate()
+        self.assertEqual(result, 1)
+        self.assertIn("@NVIDIA/training", output)
+        self.assertNotIn("Missing approvals for megatron/rl/actor.py", output)
+
+        self.pr.get_reviews.return_value = [SimpleNamespace(user=user("trainer"), state="APPROVED")]
+        self.assertEqual(self.run_gate()[0], 0)
+
+    def test_other_owners_on_the_same_file_are_still_required(self):
+        self.repo.get_contents.return_value.decoded_content = (
+            b"megatron/rl/ @NVIDIA/reinforcement-learning @NVIDIA/training @tdene\n"
+        )
+        result, output = self.run_gate()
+        self.assertEqual(result, 1)
+        self.assertIn("@NVIDIA/training", output)
+        self.assertIn("@tdene", output)
+        self.assertNotIn("@NVIDIA/reinforcement-learning", output)
+
+    def test_tdene_as_actor_or_reviewer_does_not_exempt_another_author(self):
+        self.pr.user.login = "someone-else"
+        self.pr.get_reviews.return_value = [SimpleNamespace(user=user("tdene"), state="APPROVED")]
+        with mock.patch.dict("os.environ", {"GITHUB_ACTOR": "tdene"}):
+            result, output = self.run_gate()
+        self.assertEqual(result, 1)
+        self.assertIn("@NVIDIA/reinforcement-learning", output)
+
+    def test_other_authors_can_still_pass_with_a_team_approval(self):
+        self.pr.user.login = "someone-else"
+        self.pr.get_reviews.return_value = [
+            SimpleNamespace(user=user("rl-reviewer"), state="APPROVED")
+        ]
+        self.assertEqual(self.run_gate()[0], 0)
+
+    def test_exemption_does_not_match_another_organizations_team(self):
+        self.repo.get_contents.return_value.decoded_content = (
+            b"megatron/rl/ @another-org/reinforcement-learning\n"
+        )
+        result, output = self.run_gate()
+        self.assertEqual(result, 1)
+        self.assertIn("@another-org/reinforcement-learning", output)
+
+    def test_required_github_data_failures_fail_the_gate(self):
+        # Training approval remains required even when the author is RL-exempt.
+        self.set_files("megatron/rl/actor.py", "megatron/training/training.py")
+        for target, method in (
+            (self.repo, "get_contents"),
+            (self.pr, "get_files"),
+            (self.pr, "get_reviews"),
+            (self.org, "get_team_by_slug"),
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(method=method):
+                with mock.patch.object(target, method, side_effect=RuntimeError("API unavailable")):
+                    result, output = self.run_gate()
+                self.assertEqual(result, 1)
+                self.assertIn("::error::", output)
+
+    def test_missing_token_fails_the_gate(self):
+        with mock.patch.dict("os.environ", {"GITHUB_TOKEN": ""}):
+            result, output = self.run_gate()
+        self.assertEqual(result, 1)
+        self.assertIn("GITHUB_TOKEN", output)
+
+
+class TestReviewLabels(ApprovalFixture):
+    def test_rl_only_tdene_pr_advances_to_approved(self):
+        self.swap_labels(self.tracker())
+        self.pr.add_to_labels.assert_called_once_with("Approved")
+        self.assertNotIn(

+        )

+    def test_other_authors_still_need_rl_approval(self):
+        self.pr.user.login = "someone-else"
+        with mock.patch.dict("os.environ", {"GITHUB_ACTOR": "tdene"}):
+            self.swap_labels(self.tracker(), {"tdene": "APPROVED"})
+        self.assert_no_label_changes()
+
+    def test_other_expert_teams_remain_pending(self):
+        self.set_files("megatron/rl/actor.py", "megatron/training/training.py")
+        self.swap_labels(self.tracker())
+        self.assert_no_label_changes()
+
+    def test_final_teams_remain_required_after_rl_exemption(self):
+        self.set_files("megatron/rl/actor.py", "megatron/core/config.py")
+        self.swap_labels(self.tracker())
+        self.pr.add_to_labels.assert_called_once_with("Final Review")
+
+    def test_rl_member_requesting_changes_still_blocks(self):
+        self.swap_labels(self.tracker(), {"rl-reviewer": "CHANGES_REQUESTED"})
+        self.assert_no_label_changes()
+
+    def test_core_member_requesting_changes_requires_final_review(self):
+        for reviewer in ("nemo-reviewer", "adlr-reviewer"):
+            with self.subTest(reviewer=reviewer):

+        for reviewer in ("nemo-reviewer", "adlr-reviewer"):

+                    self.pr.reset_mock()

+    def test_core_member_requesting_changes_blocks_final_review_advancement(self):
+        self.pr.labels = [SimpleNamespace(name="Final Review")]

+                self.pr.reset_mock()
+                self.swap_labels(self.tracker(), {reviewer: "CHANGES_REQUESTED"})
+                self.assert_no_label_changes()
+
+    def test_changes_requested_reverts_an_already_approved_pr(self):
+        self.pr.labels = [SimpleNamespace(name="Approved")]

+        self.pr.remove_from_labels.assert_any_call("Approved")
+        self.pr.add_to_labels.assert_not_called()
+
+    def test_draft_pr_is_not_advanced(self):
+        self.pr.draft = True
+        self.swap_labels(self.tracker())
+        self.assert_no_label_changes()
+
+    def test_review_api_failure_cannot_approve_an_exempt_pr(self):

+            swap_pr_labels.requests, "post", side_effect=RuntimeError("offline")

+    def test_graphql_errors_cannot_approve_an_exempt_pr(self):

+    def test_changed_files_failure_does_not_change_labels(self):

### Preserve final-team blockers after removing the RL requirement

**Failure:** Using the added [RL-only `tdene` fixture](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/53f3dcbbdec463a95afaa3008da34843247fc605/tests/test_utils/python_scripts/test_codeowners_approval.py#L29-L44), supply latest reviews `{"nemo-reviewer": "CHANGES_REQUESTED"}` with no existing review-stage labels. This subtraction empties both required-team sets. The reviewer is correctly retained in `pending_final`, but [the stage decision](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/53f3dcbbdec463a95afaa3008da34843247fc605/tests/test_utils/python_scripts/swap_pr_labels.py#L232-L255) sets `needs_final_review=False` because no final team owns the changed files. Consequently, [the expert-stage handler](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/53f3dcbbdec463a95afaa3008da34843247fc605/tests/test_utils/python_scripts/swap_pr_labels.py#L313-L331) adds `Approved` despite the active blocker. Before the exemption, the outstanding RL approval prevented this advancement.

**Correction:** In `swap_labels`, replace the assignment at line 247 with:

```python
needs_final_review = bool(final_required or final_non_approvers)
```

This lets the existing handler retain final-review blockers even when no final team owns these paths. The invariant is that exempting a team's mandatory approval must not exempt an individual's active change request. This is a source-traced suggestion, not an executed patch; verify it before adopting.

**Acceptance and preservation — proposed checks, not run:**
- Extend `TestReviewLabels` using its default fixture and the review above; repeat with `adlr-reviewer`. Each case should add only `Final Review`, never `Approved`. Changing that review to `APPROVED` should permit `Approved`.
- Retain the existing RL-only/no-review assertion: add `Approved` once without looking up RL membership. Retain the RL-member change-request assertion: no label changes.
- Retain the other-author and mixed-training assertions: no advancement without their required approvals; mixed RL/core changes must still add `Final Review` while core approvals are missing.
- With an existing `Approved` label, a core-team change request must remove it and return to `Final Review`; with an existing `Final Review` label, the blocker must prevent advancement.

**Follow-up to review 5639661481 (baseline `53f3dcbb` → head `d8e75dd9`).** I ran no tests; everything below comes from reading the source.

**Earlier finding is fixed: a core-team change request no longer gets bypassed on an RL-only PR by `tdene`.** [`swap_pr_labels.py` L247](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/d8e75dd9d33d3036be406256e7028e66b613df4b/tests/test_utils/python_scripts/swap_pr_labels.py#L247) now reads `needs_final_review = bool(final_required or final_non_approvers)`. I traced the earlier case at head: RL-only `tdene` PR, no stage label, and `{nemo-reviewer\|adlr-reviewer: CHANGES_REQUESTED}`.
- The exemption empties `required_teams`.
- `final_non_approvers` still holds the reviewer, so `needs_final_review` is True.
- The expert-stage handler adds `Final Review`, not `Approved`.

The related cases also behave correctly:
- If that reviewer approves instead, the PR advances to `Approved`.
- With an existing `Approved` label, a core change request removes it and re-adds `Final Review`.
- With an existing `Final Review` label, the PR stays put.
- Change requests from RL members and other non-core reviewers still block through `pending_expert`.

**Tests.** The four new `TestReviewLabels` cases in [`test_codeowners_approval.py`](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/blob/d8e75dd9d33d3036be406256e7028e66b613df4b/tests/test_utils/python_scripts/test_codeowners_approval.py#L193-L229) cover both core reviewers. `test_core_member_requesting_changes_requires_final_review` would fail on the baseline and pass at head. The other three lock in the approval, revert-from-`Approved` and stay-in-`Final Review` behaviour. None of them is vacuous: `reset_mock()` keeps the fixture's return values, and labels are set before the tracker computes its stage.

**Scope.** The only changes since the baseline are the L247 fix and those four tests. `check_codeowners_approval.py`, `multi-approval-bot.yml`, `auto-swap-labels.yml` and `cicd-main.yml` are byte-identical to the previously reviewed tree. I found no new regression above the earlier impact ceiling (moderate) in the changed code or the paths it affects.
